blendVariants.label: Maduro
blendVariants.title: Cubanitos Maduro
blendVariants.eyebrow: Broadleaf-wrapped counterpart to the Cameroon Cubanito
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Dark cocoa, molasses, espresso and a cedar-and-black-pepper finish sit at the centre of the Broadleaf-wrapped Cubanito. The aged Dominican binder and filler are the same core the Natural uses, with a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper in place of the African Cameroon, trading the Cameroon's dry aromatic spice for darker sugar and a heavier, sweeter body.
blendVariants.noteHtml: Connecticut Broadleaf at a 32 ring gauge is an unusual pairing. The Dominican core is shared with the Natural, making the wrapper the principal blend difference.
